Body.Content:
We are announcing the end of support for selected AI models on the Standard and GitHub Copilot harnesses in Copilot Studio. Beginning on each models' applicable migration date, the selected models will no longer be available in Copilot Studio, and agents will automatically migrate to a replacement model.

How does this affect me?
Agents configured with retiring models will be automatically migrated to a supported replacement model. The planned replacement model and migration date depends on both the model and the harness used by the agent.

Review your agents by harness and model to identify those using a retiring model, then work with their owners to prepare for migration.

For the latest model availability, see the guidance for your agent’s harness:
  • Standard harness model availability
  • GitHub Copilot harness model availability
Retiring model Harness Planned replacement model Migration date
GPT-4.1*StandardGPT Chat LatestNovember 12, 2026

GPT-5 Chat*GitHub CopilotGPT-6 Luna (previously GPT-5.6 Terra)November 12, 2026

GPT-5 ReasoningStandardGPT Chat LatestNovember 12, 2026
GPT 5.6 SolGitHub CopilotGPT-6.1 Sol (previously GPT-6 Sol)November 12, 2026
GPT 5.6 LunaGitHub CopilotGPT 6 LunaNovember 12, 2026

Note: For environments outside the U.S. where cross-geo data movement is restricted, GPT-4.1 and GPT-5 will remain supported and will not retire as part of this migration. To learn more about cross-geo data movement, including availability and eligibility, see Geographical availability of Copilot.

Update to planned replacement models
The planned replacement models for two GitHub Copilot harness models have changed since the original announcement:
  • GPT-5 Chat: The planned replacement is now GPT-6 Luna, previously GPT-5.6 Terra.
  • GPT-5.6 Sol: The planned replacement is now GPT-6.1 Sol, previously GPT-6 Sol.
We've updated the planned replacement models to provide improved quality at a lower cost. All other planned replacement models and migration dates remain unchanged.

GPT Chat Latest
GPT Chat Latest is the supported chat model option going forward for the Copilot Studio Standard harness. It keeps agents on the latest supported GPT chat model. Moving to a new model version is a separate change, and customers will receive at least 30 days' notice.

For agents on the GitHub Copilot harness, refer to the planned replacement model listed in the table above.

What action do I need to take?
Before the migration date for each retiring model, we recommend admins and makers take the following actions:
  1. Identify affected agents in the Power Platform admin center by going to Manage > Copilot Studio and reviewing agents by harness and model.
    • The model field is currently in preview. The inventory reflects published agent configurations, so unpublished model changes might not appear. See the admin agent inventory for details.
  2. Notify the appropriate agent owners.
  3. Test the planned replacement model, or choose another supported model that better meets quality, performance, or cost requirements.
  4. Validate response accuracy, key workflows, tool and action execution, and business-critical integrations.
  5. Adjust agent instructions or configuration if testing identifies behavior changes.
  6. Review model availability, regional availability, and any cross-geo or external model-provider requirements.
We will send an announcement with retirement dates for older versions of the Claude Opus and Claude Sonnet models. In the GitHub Copilot harness, Opus 5.5 and Sonnet 5.5 are already available for your agents.

For more information, please visit:

  • Chat Latest Model | OpenAI API

Title: Copilot Studio - Information regarding the end of support for selected AI models
